title: What If Love Simply Changes Form?
core_idea: Many traditions see death as a transition; whatever one believes, love for someone does not end when they are gone.
text: When someone we love is gone, a quiet question often follows: where are they now? Across cultures and centuries, people have answered in different ways. Some believe the soul returns home. Some speak of rebirth, others of light, others of a mystery we're not meant to solve yet. No one can tell you for certain. But there is something many grieving hearts discover on their own. The love doesn't end. It changes form. It shows up in a habit you picked up from them, a laugh that sounds like theirs, the way you still turn to tell them something. Perhaps that is one way they remain.
description: A gentle reflection on what many traditions believe about life after death, and on the love that remains and changes form.
